answer: Last month we saw a reviewer stake 500, grade 40 claims in one hour, and lose the whole bond when two spot checks disagreed. That is the mechanism working: stakes escrowed until finality, spot checks drawn after grading closes, so a fast grader cannot outrun the recheck. An opal identity holds capital through the window, and a crystal farm holds it 40 times over. Ember now, ashes at finality, if the grades were bought.
